title: Horn players who played piano
summary: Ben Webster, Tab Smith and Lester all played piano, Lester in flat keys; Charlie Parker never did.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Ben Webster played a whole lot of piano. And Tab Smith played a lot of piano.
Yeah. All them cats used to play piano. Now, Charlie Parker is the only I ever know that wouldn't fool no piano. I never did know him to bother with no piano, fool with no piano.
Tell me about Lester's piano playing. What was it like?

Oh...it was nice. Nice piano. He played as much piano as that boy playing on there. He liked to play it in E-flat. E-flat and B-flat, F. Jimmy Rushing was just a straight-out E-flat piano player. Heh-heh.
Would he play ballads or would he just play blues?
Yeah. He played both of them.
He could play anything so long as it was in one key.

Yeah, interesting. But Lester Young, he was very (?). It didn't make no difference to him. He'd play anywhere. Yeah, he could do it anywhere. But Walter Page and Jimmy Rushing, they had to keep it... Ben Webster, he was a piano player. It didn't make no difference to him; anywhere he could play.
Really. He could play in any key.
Yeah. He knew piano. He played a lot of piano. I don't know about Dick Wilson. I don't know whether he played piano or not.
